db_dir.description: Directory where wordlist.db and metadata files are stored (overrides BOGOFILTER_DIR and $HOME/.bogofilter).

spam_cutoff.description: Threshold (0..1) above which messages are marked as spam.

ham_cutoff.description: Threshold (0..1) below which messages are marked as ham (or unsure in tristate mode if spam_cutoff != ham_cutoff).

robx.description: Prior probability (0..1) assigned to tokens not yet seen in training.

robs.description: Weight (0..1) for robx when computing probabilities for tokens with few occurrences.

min_dev.description: Minimum absolute deviation from 0.5 required for a token's probability to be used in classification.

sp_esf.description: Spam effective size factor for redundancy adjustment; >1.0 reduces influence of redundant tokens.

ns_esf.description: Non-spam effective size factor for redundancy adjustment; >1.0 reduces influence of redundant tokens.

log_enabled.description: If true, enables logging to syslog when the -l option is used at runtime.

spam_header_name.description: Header field name used for the X-Bogosity classification line (e.g., X-Spam-Status).

parse_headers.description: If true, tokens in email headers are tagged; disable only for special testing.

cache_size.description: Berkeley DB cache size in MiB (1 MiB = 1,048,576 bytes). 0 = default (recommended: ~1/3 of DB file size).
